unknown_water_rule: UNKNOWN is never converted to SUITABLE. Actionable crop water guidance is provided to farmers based on true crop water requirements.

ahilya_nagar_kharif_case_study.canal_zones: Pravara and Godavari irrigation project command areas support high water crops like Sugarcane.
ahilya_nagar_kharif_case_study.rainfed_zones: Parner, Pathardi, Jamkhed, Shevgaon talukas rely on low/moderate water crops like Bajra, Moong, Soybean, Cotton, Onion.
ahilya_nagar_kharif_case_study.farmer_guidance_policy: Translates water status into concrete irrigation advice without exposing technical UNKNOWN flags.
